rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=0.0001, epochs=9, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=460, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=720, seed=123, rationale=iter-18 PROBE itnet_k=1 (depth-down). Investigation: k=3->2 was the iter-9 breakout (hr 0.336->0.361); deeper k=3 capped ~0.337, wider unet_c=24 HURT (iter-4 0.296), epochs>9 diminishing, train_n=460 is staged cap. The depth gradient is the ONLY lever with a directional signal: reducing unrolled depth helped (matches v1/v2 family breakouts). k=1 is the single untried depth step and is cheaper (~700s, well inside 20-min). iter-16 best_hr=0.3697 is GPU/seed NOISE not signal: iters 9-15 (identical cfg) clustered 0.3608-0.3624 spread 0.0016, 0.3697 is a +0.7% lucky-val excursion and iter-17 (same cfg) regressed to 0.3676 with PSNR/SSIM flat. BASE_ITER=16 (hr-best). Predicted: SSIM ~0.92, hr ~0.36-0.38 (probe could clear 0.3697 if shallower-prior trend holds, or regress if k=1 too shallow to retain unrolled benefit).
